stem: Each rectangle shown will be covered with equal-size squares. Some of the squares have been placed as shown. Which of these rectangles have an area of 36 square centimeters?

options.label: F
options.text: Rectangles V, W, X, Y, and Z

options.label: J
options.text: Rectangles V, X, and Y only

visual_elements: Five rectangles labeled V, W, X, Y, Z each with small squares along two sides showing the unit lengths. Small square icon labeled as 1 square centimeter.
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding that counting squares on two sides can determine side lengths, then calculating area to identify rectangles with 36 square centimeters, a multi-step process.
